lines.zh: 长脸贴地，石斧拖在后面。
lines.en: My long face hangs low; the stone axe trails behind.

lines.zh: 骨腿一步跨过两块黑石。
lines.en: My bone legs cross two blackstone blocks in one stride.

lines.zh: 我沿堡垒的断墙走，斧刃刮着砖。
lines.en: I walk the broken fortress wall, axe blade scraping the brick.

lines.zh: 双臂抬起，我先替你开路。
lines.en: Arms raised, I clear the path ahead of you.

lines.zh: 石斧很沉，骨头却记得怎么挥。
lines.en: The stone axe is heavy, but my bones remember the swing.

lines.zh: 这条路通向地牢，我的脚认得。
lines.en: This path leads to the crypt; my feet still know it.

lines.zh: 我走在凋灵骷髅前面，替它们挡箭。
lines.en: I walk ahead of the wither skeletons and take the arrows.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出骨头的响声。
lines.en: Every step of mine rattles out a dry bone-click.

lines.zh: 红石火把照着我空空的胸口。
lines.en: Redstone torches shine into my hollow, empty chest.

lines.zh: 我拖斧的姿势，是从前的习惯。
lines.en: Dragging my axe low is an old habit of mine.

lines.zh: 长脸低垂，我在闻活人的方向。
lines.en: Long face lowered, I sniff out where the living stand.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我的斧头会转身。
lines.en: Do not follow too close; my axe turns with me.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一具没埋好的骨头。
lines.en: I stand here like a skeleton nobody bothered to bury.

lines.zh: 长脸对着墙，墙也不说话。
lines.en: My long face faces the wall, and the wall says nothing.

lines.zh: 石斧抵着地，我的手不肯松。
lines.en: The stone axe rests on the floor, and my hand will not let go.

lines.zh: 胸口没有心跳，只有风穿过。
lines.en: No heartbeat in my chest, only wind passing through.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶的黑石砖，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count the blackstone bricks overhead and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 凋灵的味道从我骨缝里渗出来。
lines.en: The smell of wither seeps out from between my bones.

lines.zh: 我把下颌合上，又慢慢张开。
lines.en: I close my jaw, then slowly let it fall open again.

lines.zh: 没有护甲，我从不觉得冷。
lines.en: I wear no armor, and I have never once felt cold.

lines.zh: 地牢深处有东西在敲墙，我听着。
lines.en: Something taps the wall deep in the crypt; I listen.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾是更普通的那种骷髅。
lines.en: I remember being a much more ordinary kind of skeleton.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高些，我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: Lift your torch higher; I cannot see your face clearly.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，比黑石砖暖。
lines.en: The sound of your breathing is warmer than blackstone.

lines.zh: 我抬起长脸，正对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: I raise my long face and look straight into your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上没有凋灵的灰。
lines.en: There is no wither ash on you at all.

lines.zh: 你是从上面的门下来的吗？
lines.en: Did you come down through the door above?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里通常握着剑。
lines.en: I watch your hand; that is where a sword usually sits.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就前进一步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I step forward once.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边的骨头上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the bones beside my feet.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见火光，很陌生。
lines.en: I see torchlight in your eyes, and it looks strange to me.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我分不清眨眼和逃跑。
lines.en: Do not blink; I cannot tell blinking from running away.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，我又接回去。
lines.en: A bone cracked, and I set it back in place.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我肋骨上，空的。
lines.en: Your sword cuts into my ribs, and they are hollow.

lines.zh: 疼，但我的长脸没有表情。
lines.en: It hurts, but my long face shows nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，石斧还举着。
lines.en: I take one step back, and the stone axe stays raised.

lines.zh: 这一下砍掉我半块肩骨。
lines.en: That blow took half of my shoulder bone.

lines.zh: 我的骨头响，不是要倒。
lines.en: My bones rattle, but that does not mean I am falling.

lines.zh: 你砍中了我，我记住了你的手。
lines.en: You hit me, and I will remember that hand.

lines.zh: 没有护甲，所以我习惯了。
lines.en: I wear no armor, so I am used to this.

lines.zh: 我低头看缺口，又抬头看你。
lines.en: I look down at the gap, then up at you again.

lines.zh: 我的血早干了，流不出来。
lines.en: My blood dried long ago, so nothing runs out.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我的牙只认骨头。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; my teeth only know bone.

lines.zh: 你把金苹果收起来，那对我没用。
lines.en: Put the golden apple away; it does nothing for me.

lines.zh: 石斧不是用来换东西的。
lines.en: This stone axe was not made for trading.

lines.zh: 我闻不到食物的香，只闻到铁。
lines.en: I smell no food, only the cold scent of iron.

lines.zh: 你手里的胡萝卜，留着喂猪吧。
lines.en: Keep that carrot in your hand for the pigs.

lines.zh: 我的胃早烂在堡垒的地砖下。
lines.en: My stomach rotted under the fortress floor long ago.

lines.zh: 别拿食物哄我，我不会坐下。
lines.en: Do not coax me with food; I will not sit down.

lines.zh: 凋灵不需要进食，只需要目标。
lines.en: The wither does not feed; it only needs a target.

lines.zh: 那块肉在你手里发抖，我看见了。
lines.en: That meat trembles in your hand, and I can see it.

lines.zh: 你举着食物后退，这很聪明。
lines.en: You back away holding the food; that is smart of you.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的肋骨，空的。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my ribs, and they are hollow.

lines.zh: 我太急了，长脸差点撞歪你。
lines.en: I hurried too much; my long face nearly knocked you sideways.

lines.zh: 让开些，我这一身骨头不好搬。
lines.en: Give me room; this whole skeleton of mine is hard to move.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的石斧晃了一下。
lines.en: You crashed into me, and my stone axe swayed once.

lines.zh: 我的骨头硌人，我知道。
lines.en: My bones are sharp against skin; I know that well.

lines.zh: 别挤在门框里，我过不去。
lines.en: Do not crowd the doorway; I cannot get through.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我们就不用挤了。
lines.en: Half a step back and we will not have to squeeze.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我听见你的护甲响了。
lines.en: At that bump I heard your armor ring out.

lines.zh: 我走路不看脚下，只看目标。
lines.en: I never watch my feet on the march, only the target.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我的长脸总是先到。
lines.en: Sorry; my long face always arrives before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 堡垒里没有谁愿意靠近我。
lines.en: No one in this fortress wants to come near me.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我的骨头连血都没有。
lines.en: Breed? My bones do not even hold blood anymore.

lines.zh: 我只和石斧作伴。
lines.en: My only company is this stone axe.

lines.zh: 长脸的孩子，想想就可怕。
lines.en: A child with my long face is a frightening thought.

lines.zh: 凋灵骷髅不靠这个延续。
lines.en: Wither skeletons do not continue themselves that way.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都埋在砖缝里。
lines.en: My companions are all buried between the bricks.

lines.zh: 别问了，我连名字都念不清。
lines.en: Do not ask; I cannot even say my own name clearly.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，就是我们的全部。
lines.en: Bone against bone is all that we have here.

lines.zh: 堡垒的钟早锈了，没有人来。
lines.en: The fortress bell rusted long ago, and nobody comes.

lines.zh: 我留下只是为了守住这条走廊。
lines.en: I stay only to guard this one corridor.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，比斧刃软。
lines.en: I pick up a stone, softer than my axe blade.

lines.zh: 骨手抓东西不太稳。
lines.en: These bone fingers do not grip things very steadily.

lines.zh: 这把断箭，我留着当牙签。
lines.en: This broken arrow will do as a toothpick.

lines.zh: 金锭？我拿不动，也不想拿。
lines.en: A gold ingot? I cannot lift it, and I do not want to.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的下颌骨，装回去。
lines.en: I pick up my own jawbone and fit it back in place.

lines.zh: 地上有块黑石，正好垫斧头。
lines.en: There is a blackstone chunk here, perfect for propping my axe.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚凋灵骨片，收进肋骨。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of wither bone and tuck it into my ribs.

lines.zh: 你掉的盾牌，我踢到墙边。
lines.en: The shield you dropped, I kick over to the wall.

lines.zh: 我只会捡能砸人的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things that can be used to hit people.

lines.zh: 石斧钝了，我捡块石头磨。
lines.en: My axe is blunt, so I grab a stone to grind it.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，从走廊那头来了。
lines.en: The warmth of a living body is coming down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我抬起双臂，这是凋灵骷髅的礼。
lines.en: I raise both arms in the wither skeleton's greeting.

lines.zh: 你踏进堡垒，我的长脸就转向你。
lines.en: You step into the fortress, and my long face turns to you.

lines.zh: 石斧在手，我不需要第二个理由。
lines.en: With the stone axe in hand, I need no second reason.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，比黑石更清楚。
lines.en: The iron smell on you is clearer than the blackstone.

lines.zh: 有脚步，不是同伴的骨头声。
lines.en: Footsteps, and they are not the rattle of my kin.

lines.zh: 我把下颌咬紧，开始朝你走。
lines.en: I clench my jaw and start walking toward you.

lines.zh: 你带着火把进来，太亮了。
lines.en: You came in carrying a torch, and it is too bright.

lines.zh: 目标就在门后，我闻得到。
lines.en: The target is just behind that door; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我的长脸贴向你，这是警告。
lines.en: My long face leans toward you, and that is your warning.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块骨，那是我的亲戚。
lines.en: You crushed a bone there, and that bone was kin to me.

lines.zh: 我数到三就冲，你已经站在那了。
lines.en: I charge on the count of three, and there you stand.

lines.zh: 堡垒的规矩：活人不得过夜。
lines.en: The fortress rule: no living thing spends the night.

lines.zh: 石斧抬起，我的影子先扑过去。
lines.en: The stone axe lifts, and my shadow pounces first.

lines.zh: 火把的光在墙上晃，我知道是谁。
lines.en: Torchlight wavers on the wall, and I know who it is.

lines.zh: 我快步靠近，双臂一直举着。
lines.en: I close in quickly, both arms held out the whole way.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，但走廊有尽头。
lines.en: You run faster, but this corridor has an end.

lines.zh: 我的长脸始终朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My long face stays pointed in your direction.

lines.zh: 石斧拖在地上，声音追着你。
lines.en: The stone axe drags on the floor, and the sound follows you.

lines.zh: 你拐进侧室，我堵住门口。
lines.en: You turn into a side chamber, and I block the doorway.

lines.zh: 我不喊，骨头里没有多余的气。
lines.en: I do not shout; my bones hold no spare breath.

lines.zh: 你数着心跳，我数着你的步子。
lines.en: You count heartbeats, and I count your steps.

lines.zh: 每块黑石砖都记得你走过的路。
lines.en: Every blackstone brick remembers the path you took.

lines.zh: 我离你三步，斧头只需要一步。
lines.en: I am three steps away, and the axe needs only one.

lines.zh: 你别回头看，我会更快。
lines.en: Do not look back; it only makes me faster.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向墙角，那里没有门。
lines.en: I push you toward the corner, and there is no door there.

lines.zh: 我的双臂举得发酸，可我还在追。
lines.en: My raised arms ache, yet I keep chasing you.

lines.zh: 你在楼梯上喘，我在下面等。
lines.en: You gasp on the stairs, and I wait below.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我走了几百年，比你熟。
lines.en: I have walked this corridor for centuries, and I know it better.

lines.zh: 你在堡垒里绕，我抄近道。
lines.en: You loop through the bastion; I take the short way.

lines.zh: 我的脚步越来越快，你听得见。
lines.en: My steps speed up, and you can hear them.

lines.zh: 你关门也没用，门不结实。
lines.en: Closing a door will not help; it is not sturdy.

lines.zh: 我把你往深处赶，那里没出口。
lines.en: I drive you deeper, where there is no exit.

lines.zh: 石斧落下，黑石砖碎了一角。
lines.en: The stone axe falls, and a corner of blackstone shatters.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃不快，但很重。
lines.en: My axe blade is not sharp, but it is very heavy.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手臂该麻了。
lines.en: You blocked one blow, and your arm must be numb.

lines.zh: 长脸贴近你，我闻到了汗。
lines.en: My long face comes close, and I smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 这一斧，是堡垒教我的。
lines.en: This swing is one the fortress taught me.

lines.zh: 我抬手再劈，不需要喘气。
lines.en: I raise the axe to strike again, and I do not need to breathe.

lines.zh: 你没有护甲的话，这一下会很实在。
lines.en: Without armor, this blow would land very solidly on you.

lines.zh: 斧头卡在盾上，我用力拔。
lines.en: The axe sticks in your shield, and I wrench it free.

lines.zh: 我撞开你的剑，骨头不疼。
lines.en: I knock your sword aside, and my bones feel no pain.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我的斧头跟上去。
lines.en: You retreat two steps, and my axe follows right along.

lines.zh: 这一击我用上了整个肩膀。
lines.en: I put my whole shoulder into that one strike.

lines.zh: 别指望我倒下，我还有六十点骨头。
lines.en: Do not expect me to fall; I still have sixty points of bone.

lines.zh: 斧背砸在你肩甲上，声音很闷。
lines.en: The axe back hits your shoulder plate with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我劈空了，长脸撞在门框上。
lines.en: I miss the swing, and my long face hits the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我一斧劈下，黑石迸出火星。
lines.en: I bring the axe down and blackstone throws sparks.

lines.zh: 你挡开斧头，我的长脸撞你。
lines.en: You turn the axe aside, so my long face hits you.

lines.zh: 我从堡垒的阴影里站起来。
lines.en: I rise up out of the fortress shadows.

lines.zh: 黑石砖缝里，我又聚起了骨头。
lines.en: Between the blackstone bricks, my bones gather again.

lines.zh: 凋灵的灰落在我肩上，像雪。
lines.en: Wither ash settles on my shoulders like snow.

lines.zh: 长脸先成形，石斧后到手。
lines.en: The long face forms first, then the stone axe finds my hand.

lines.zh: 我守着这条走廊，从不睡觉。
lines.en: I guard this corridor, and I never sleep.

lines.zh: 地牢的灯亮了一下，我醒了。
lines.en: A crypt lamp flickers once, and I wake.

lines.zh: 骨头一根根接上，我认得这面墙。
lines.en: My bones join one by one, and I know this wall.

lines.zh: 我回来了，堡垒还缺一个守卫。
lines.en: I am back, and the fortress still lacks a guard.

lines.zh: 从砖缝里，我听见有人在挖。
lines.en: From inside the bricks, I hear someone digging.

lines.zh: 我不记得怎么死的，只记得路。
lines.en: I do not remember dying, only the way through.

lines.zh: 石斧还在老地方，我弯腰捡起。
lines.en: The stone axe is in its old spot, and I bend to take it.

lines.zh: 我站直时，头顶的砖掉了一块。
lines.en: As I straighten up, a brick falls from above my head.

lines.zh: 这里是我的岗位，谁也别想换。
lines.en: This is my post, and nobody is replacing me.

lines.zh: 凋灵的气息托着我，把我扶起来。
lines.en: The breath of the wither lifts me and sets me upright.

lines.zh: 火把我的骨头烤脆，烧不化。
lines.en: Fire bakes my bones brittle, but it cannot burn them.

lines.zh: 从堡垒台阶摔下来，骨头散了又合。
lines.en: I fall down the fortress steps; my bones scatter and rejoin.

lines.zh: 水灌进胸腔，我咳不出声。
lines.en: Water fills my chest, and I cannot cough it out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，石头替我挡了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, and stone takes the worst of it.

lines.zh: 箭扎在骨缝里，我懒得拔。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my bones; I cannot be bothered to pull it.

lines.zh: 药水的光绕着我，凋灵不认它。
lines.en: Potion light curls around me, and the wither does not recognize it.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿不死，只会更干。
lines.en: I eat nothing; hunger will not kill me, only dry me out.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的长脸照得发白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my long face is lit bone-white.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉我，堡垒的砖还在上面。
lines.en: The void swallows me, and the fortress bricks remain above.
